MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.NAME: Gram
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.ORIGIN:
Odin thrust it into Branstock, and only Sigmund could pull it out.
Odin himself broke it, and Regin forged it anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_INT:
Deep inside the tomb, a blade broken in two is ringing.
Gram, the sword Odin broke with his own hand.
As Regin did, the two pieces must be forged anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SAF: Set the pieces together and slowly forge them anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_GAM: Test the new blade by striking the anvil.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SUC: The new blade split the anvil in two.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SHA: Gram broke in two once more. Still, the blade does not leave the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.NAME: Ganjiang & Moye
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.TAGLI: A male and a female sword, finished after three years by a smith couple who put their hair and nails into the furnace.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.COST: Takes 2 slots · Max HP -6 the first time
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.ORIGI:
The king ordered the swords made within three months.
The couple finished the two blades after three years.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.FORGE:
The iron will not melt. The three-month deadline has long passed.
They say the smith couple put their hair and nails into the furnace.
A pair of swords finished after three years, with three hundred children working the bellows.
Human spirit is lacking. Put something greater into the furnace.
The male and female blades ring with one voice.
The male and female blades melt down together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.NAME: Kusanagi
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.TAGLI: The sword that gathers the clouds of heaven; the grass-cutting sword.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.COST: Lose HP when a combat in which it was summoned ends · Can be switched to only twice per combat
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.ORIGI:
Susanoo found the sword inside the tail of the eight-headed serpent.
In a wildfire, it cut the grass and opened a way.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.FORGE:
Clouds gather at its tip. Its first name was the sword that gathers the clouds of heaven.
It is the blade Susanoo found inside the tail of Yamata no Orochi.
After it cut the grass in a wildfire, it became the "grass-cutting sword".
Polish it with care, as one tends a sacred treasure.
Carry it back into the wildfire.
The clouds part and the blade grows clear.
An unexplained fever rises. It was once said that Emperor Tenmu's illness was this sword's doing.
As the sword was once moved from the palace to Atsuta Shrine, it is enshrined deep within the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.STAGE: One of the Three Sacred Treasures
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.NAME: Tyrfing
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.TAGLIN: It never misses and always grants victory.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.COST: From level 3: a curse each of the first 3 times you use it (three evil deeds)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.ORIGIN:
A sword the dwarves Dvalinn and Durin forged as the price of their lives.
Each time it is drawn, someone dies.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.FORGE_:
A golden hilt, a blade that shines like flame.
The dwarves Dvalinn and Durin made it as the price of their lives.
It never misses and never rusts, but each time it is drawn it must kill someone.
Hone it on the whetstone without drawing it.
Draw the blade, knowing that someone will die.
Iron and stone part like cloth.
Another of the dwarves' curses awakens.
The blade turned on its master. Svafrlami, too, died by this sword. Tyrfing is gone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.NAME: Dáinsleif
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.TAGL: Dáinn's legacy. A wound it scratches never heals.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.COST: Cannot gain Block while it is your current sword
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.ORIG:
Högni drew this sword.
From that day on, the battle never ends.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.FORG:
Dáinn's legacy, a sword made by the dwarf Dáinn.
When Högni drew it, reconciliation became impossible.
The battle repeats forever.
Even out the edge without leaving the sheath.
The blade remembers a path that never misses.
The sound of an endless battle will not leave your ears.
The blade will not return to its sheath. Dáinsleif is gone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.NAME: Durandal
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.TAGLI: A sword that holds holy relics and cannot be broken.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.COST: Cannot be switched to at 30% HP or less
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.ORIGI:
From an angel to Charlemagne, from Charlemagne to Roland.
Struck against a rock ten times, it did not take a single nick.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.FORGE:
Inside the golden hilt: a tooth of Saint Peter, the blood of Saint Basil, hair of Saint Denis, a piece of the Virgin Mary's clothing.
The sword Roland struck against a rock ten times without a single nick.
Clean the relics in the hilt one by one.
Strike it against the rock ten times.
Without a single nick, it has grown harder.
Instead of a nick, the rock stays in your hand.
As with Roland, the sword hides away beneath someone's body.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.NAME: Sköfnung
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.TAGLI: The finest sword of the North, home to the souls of twelve berserkers.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.COST: Cannot be used on the first turn of combat
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.ORIGI:
A sword taken from the grave of Hrólf Kraki.
Sunlight must never touch its hilt.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.FORGE:
The sword of Hrólf Kraki, called the best of all swords ever carried in the North.
The souls of the twelve berserkers who guarded the king dwell in it.
Taboo: sunlight must never touch its hilt.
In the shade, wrap the hilt and hone the edge.
Wake the twelve souls and call them into the blade.
Twelve breaths overlap on the blade.
The stone that heals its wounds has slipped into your pack.
Sunlight touched the hilt. The sword that came out of a grave vanishes again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.NAME: Onimaru
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.TAGLIN: The blade that moved by itself and cut down an oni.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.COST: Sometimes attacks on its own whim in normal combats
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.ORIGIN:
A blade recorded in the Taiheiki.
It cut down a demon without its master's hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.FORGE_:
Without its master's hand, the sword moves by itself.
The Taiheiki records that it moved on its own and cut down an oni.
A tachi the Kyōhō Meibutsuchō named the foremost of five.
Let the blade swing once, as it wishes.
Set the blade free to move by itself.
The blade moves faster, on its own.
The blade slips your hand and moves as it pleases.
The blade leaves on its own, hunting oni.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.STAGE3: One of the Five Swords Under Heaven
The Torch of Nuada, the Sword of Light.
All light is lost if another sword is current at the end of your turn

One of the four treasures brought from Findias.
Once drawn from its sheath of death, none escaped it.

The Sword of Light, also called the Torch of Nuada.
One of the four treasures of the Tuatha Dé Danann, brought from the northern city of Findias.
Once drawn from its sheath of death, none escaped it.
Gather light while it rests in the sheath.
Draw it from the sheath in one motion.
A light no one can resist settles on the blade.
Your arm goes numb. You think of Nuada, who lost his arm and gave up the throne.
The light goes out, and the sheath is empty.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.NAME: Caladbolg
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.TAGL: Fergus's sword, which grew as large as a rainbow and cut the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.COST: Deals less damage when there is only one enemy
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.ORIG:
The sword of Leite from the fairy mound.
It cut the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.FORG:
The sword of Leite from the fairy mound. Its name means "hard cleft" or "hard blade".
When Fergus mac Róich raised it to strike, the blade grew as large as a rainbow in the air.
That blade cut the tops off three hills.
Lower the point and dress the hard blade.
Raise it until it grows as large as a rainbow.
The top of a hill has been cut away.
The point stopped before the king. It could not strike what it should have struck.
The blade vanishes beyond the hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.FULL_NOTE: [red]The tomb has no room. A sword must be sent back.[/red]
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ACQUIRED_AGAIN: [gold]{Sword}[/gold] has returned to the tomb. Its sleeping cards return with it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SHATTER_RULE: lose the sword (its cards are stored in the tomb)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.NIBELUNG: A tuft of wool set adrift on the river is cut apart the moment it touches the blade. The sword that slew Fáfnir has returned. ...And the Nibelung Treasure followed it.

The tomb's door opens again, this time from somewhere deeper.
The swords already floating at your side make room to welcome a new one.{FullNote}
Instead, give one of your swords a [gold]Safe Upgrade[/gold] (level +1).
Call none of them. Gain [gold]{PassGold}[/gold] Gold.

Ganjiang and Moye take two places in the tomb.
Offer {MaxHpCost} Max HP: human spirit is lacking.
Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and take Ganjiang & Moye.
You called none of them. The tomb's ringing fades.

Instead of welcoming a new sword, you temper the one at your side.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold]: level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_EPITAPH_EVENT.title: Epitaph of the Sword Grave
In a deep valley you stand before an epitaph carved where swords were buried.
Beneath the wooden plaque, a hilt juts out of the earth.
When you touch it, the tomb at your back hums low.
Pull It Out
Gain a magic sword you do not own.
Wrench It Free
Lose [red]{ForceHpLoss}[/red] HP. Choose one of two magic swords.
Read the Epitaph
Lose [red]{ReadHpLoss}[/red] HP. Give one of your swords a [gold]Safe Upgrade[/gold] (level +1).
Cover It Up
Cover it with earth. Gain [gold]{CoverGold}[/gold] Gold.

You brush the earth aside and a blade appears: [gold]{Sword}[/gold].
{Tagline}
Take It
Bring this sword into the tomb. If there is no room, send one sword back.
Take Them
Offer [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP: human spirit is lacking. Bring Ganjiang & Moye into the tomb (2 slots).
Bury It Again
Return the sword to the earth.
You cover the blade with earth. Only the wooden plaque remains.

Ganjiang and Moye take two places in the tomb.
Offer {MaxHpCost} Max HP: human spirit is lacking.
Offer
Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and take Ganjiang & Moye.
Give Up
Return the swords to the earth.
In the end, the hilt slipped from your hands.

You read the epitaph to the end. The sword at your side answers it.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold]: level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
You cover the hilt with earth. A few gold coins come up on your fingertips.
